summary: Itasca County, MN 100-ft stairway tower on the Chippewa NF; a CCC camp erected it (1936 per one list); sold and removed in the 1972 tower sale.

events.note: Erected by a CCC camp, per A-Z list; the list's table gives 1937
Bids opened June 8, 1972 for the sale of the tower
Sold and removed in the 1972 Chippewa National Forest tower sale

evidence.supports: Chippewa National Forest named as agency for the Itasca County site
tower offered for sale in 1972; bids opened June 8, 1972; airplane patrols proven superior
evidence.quote: June 8, 1972: Bids were opened for the sale of the tower, airplane patrols have proven to be superior to the tower.
on Lake was a 100 foot Aermotor stairway lookout.

evidence.supports: erected by a CCC camp in 1936
evidence.quote: Sioux CCC camp erected it in 1936.

evidence.supports: sold in the 1972 Chippewa National Forest tower sale and removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The A-Z list gives 1937 in its table but says a CCC camp erected the tower in 1936. The story uses the 1936 erection and reports the 1937 table year as a disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Only two lookout pages and one statewide A-Z list PDF (not a county list). No staffing, fire, or site-condition sources found. Conflicts: table year 1937 vs CCC erection 1936. The 120-ft 1959 survey note is not Dixon's: in the PDF it sits between the Devil Fish and Dixon Lake notes, so it was dropped. Commons has a related Itasca County Towers PDF (File:Itasca_County_Towers.pdf) whose upload path I did not find, so it was not read. The site today is undescribed; the road name is the only site detail.
